reason: Redirect-only by design (AT-5/AT-6, docs/03-features/attachments.md): the handler unconditionally returns 302 to a five-minute presigned download URL and never a 2xx of its own -- the actual bytes are served from the URL it redirects to, not from this operation. Redocly's operation-2xx-response rule has no way to know a redirect-only success path is the complete, intended contract rather than a missing response.
decision: docs/07-planning/decision-log.md, 2026-09-28, "Redocly-lint-finding allowlist added for GET /attachments/{id}'s redirect-only response"
